text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is here at last. Голд Сити
turns to
me asking why I was so
persistent in making sure
she kept
running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tell her it was because I understood she
wanted
to run. She laughs at me,
astonished.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:

to run. She laughs at me,
astonished.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити tells me that she's glad to
have chosen
me as her trainer. Promising
that she'll run like
herself, she heads off
to today's race of
champions!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
